name: PHDZ_2021_Dashboard
title: Peel Health Data Zones - Social Determinants of Health - Census Variables (2021)
description:
The Peel Health Data Zone Information Tool (the tool) replaces the Peel Health Data Zone profiles, previously hosted on the Health Status Data Website. The purpose of the tool is to illustrate geographic patterns in the social determinants of health across Peel using the Peel Health Data Zones (PHDZ) as the primary geographic boundary. It is a publicly accessible tool. PHDZs are a custom-built geographic boundary. Work to develop the PHDZs arose out of a need for assessing health status at a level of geography that balances individual privacy and meaningful analysis to support decision-making. The PHDZs are geographic areas within Peel created using stable geographic units (census tracts) that share similar economic status and social conditions. Where possible the PHDZs respect natural and human-made boundaries.
 

  • The tool complements other data tools hosted by the Region of Peel including the Census Information Hub.
  • The tool differs from the original profiles in the following ways:
             • Interactive dashboard built in ArcGIS rather than static PDFs.
             • Built using the newly updated Peel Health Data Zone boundaries (n=40)                     instead of the original boundaries (n=15).
             • Collection of indicators varies slightly.

Phase 1 of the tool displays sociodemographic information from the 2021 Canadian Census of Population. Health data will be added to the tool throughout 2024. Public Health staff consulted with internal and external partners during the development of the tool. 

How the Tool will be Used

Users of the tool will be able to explore information on the following themes: population; housing; families; race, ethnicity, language; immigration; income; employment; and education. Supporting information is also available through the ‘About’, ‘Definitions’, and ‘Map Styles’ tabs. 

The tool can be customized to focus on the Peel-wide picture, a single municipality, or a single Peel Health Data Zone. Through consultations , we’ve heard from external partners that the tool will help them learn about the areas in Peel that they serve, inform grant applications and other funding advocacy, and guide planning and prioritization processes.
snippet: This feature layer includes the attribute data used to create the maps and indicators found on Social Determinants of Health tab of the  Peel Health Data Zone Information Tool (PHDZ-IT). The Peel Health Data Zone Information Tool presents data from the 2021 Canadian Census of Population to illustrate geographic variation in the social determinants of health and other important indicators across Peel. The tool is meant to serve as one input into planning and prioritization processes that aim to improve the health of Peel’s residents. Understanding the lived experiences, perspectives, beliefs and behaviours of individuals and groups through qualitative approaches are also needed.
